answer: The lagoon test I would run is Certified prison officer commission with prison service attestation: a commission the service renews after wing audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a commission the service renews after wing audits stays private; the anchor is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the ledge of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
